proposed_paragraph: Writers need not approach these conversations alone. The Screenwriters Association offers its members guidance on contracts and copyright. The Screenwriters Rights Association of India accepts applications from eligible writers with story, screenplay or dialogue credits in any language; its terms make clear that joining does not mean immediate royalty payments. These are practical places to explore while writers and producers work out how a particular story will travel.
